post.description: Public (self.unsubscribe, c14), idempotent: turns off email for the link's scope. Also the RFC 8058 one-click target: the mail client's form body (List-Unsubscribe=One-Click) is accepted and ignored; no CSRF token or session is needed (the token is the authority). 404 for an invalid token or a user who is no longer active; 403 insufficient_scope for all=true with a token that is not scoped to all.
